name: NoPoSplat
definition: A method that eliminates the need for known camera poses by using a canonical coordinate system anchored to a single input view and introducing intrinsics token embeddings to resolve scale ambiguity.
summary: NoPoSplat is a pose-free 3D Gaussian Splatting method that eliminates camera pose dependencies by anchoring to a reference view and using intrinsics tokens to resolve scale ambiguity.
